blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for Ranch Park. It has no local notes, street boundaries, schools or listing feed yet; see the open items below.

Ranch Park, Coquitlam: 17 houses and 2 condos and townhomes listed at the end of October, with 4 and 1 sold in the month. It is one of 23 communities the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures break out for Coquitlam.
Ranch Park homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

Ranch Park, October 2026. Detached houses: 17 listed at month end and 4 sold in October, a sales ratio of 24% (a sellers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 2 listed at month end and 1 sold in October, a sales ratio of 50%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and October 2026, detached houses: listings fell from 41 in June to 17 in October (−58.5%), and it took 4.8% of the city’s 273 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings was 1 in June and 2 in October, too few (under 3) to call a rise or fall, and it took 0.7% of the city’s 596 sales over the period.
The monthly write-ups singled out Ranch Park for detached houses in September, October (a sellers’ best bet); detached houses in June, July (a buyers’ best bet).
Ranch Park share of Coquitlam listings and sales by month

In Ranch Park, its share of the houses listed in Coquitlam went from 9.2% in June to 4.5% in October and its share of the condos and townhomes listed went from 0.1% to 0.3%. A share that holds steady while the city moves means the community is following the city; a share that drifts means it is moving differently.

blocks.text: Ranch Park home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

32 houses sold in Ranch Park with a median price of $1,485,000 (the middle half sold between $1,384,625 and $1,796,000), taking a median of 24 days to sell at 95.6% of the last list price; 9% sold above list. They had a median $579 per square foot, a median year built of 1973 and a median lot of 8,911 square feet. 6 townhomes sold in Ranch Park with a median price of $622,500, taking a median of 11 days to sell at 95.5% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $422 per square foot, a median year built of 1977 and a median strata fee of $307 a month.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Ranch Park?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 17 houses and 2 condos and townhomes listed in Ranch Park. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Ranch Park a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 24% (a sellers’ market); condos and townhomes had 50% on only 2 listed, too few to read as a market type. The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Ranch Park from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 13 houses and 4 condos and townhomes sold in Ranch Park over those 5 months; detached houses peaked in September with 4 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in June with 2 sold.

faq.q: How big is Ranch Park compared with the rest of Coquitlam?
faq.a: In October 2026, Ranch Park held 4.5% of the 378 detached houses listed in Coquitlam and 0.3% of the 779 condos and townhomes listed in Coquitlam.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Ranch Park?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses made up 89.5% of the 19 homes listed in Ranch Park and condos and townhomes made up 10.5%; of the 5 that sold, houses were 80.0% and condos and townhomes 20.0%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Ranch Park than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 41 in June to 17 in October 2026 (−58.5%); condos and townhomes was 1 in June and 2 in October 2026, too few (under 3) to call a rise or fall.

faq.q: What did houses in Ranch Park sell for?
faq.a: 32 houses sold in Ranch Park between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,485,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Ranch Park?
faq.a: The median was 24 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.6% of the last list price (9% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
